rationale: P identifies whether required braking is initiated and performed—the system behaviour directly required to evaluate T. SG-1 and FR-7 establish braking itself as the subject, while FR-7.1 establishes obstacle detection as a trigger for braking initiation. P uses timely detection as a condition rather than expanding into sensing mechanisms or their timing performance. Its operational scope matches the supplied hazard.
determining_elements: "Whether braking is initiated and performed" directly characterises omission of required braking, supported by SG-1 and FR-7.

"When an obstacle is detected in time" provides the triggering context for braking; FR-7.1 explicitly requires braking initiation after detection within a dangerous zone. P does not incorporate the detection pipeline as an additional phenomenon.
The straight-ahead, single-lane-road scenario at 50 km/h in good weather, with a pedestrian crossing 20 m ahead, matches H-1's operational situation.
